CAS — 352-21-6. Profile Aminohydroxybutyric acid has been claimed to be of value in a variety of neurological disorders including use as an adjunct in the treatment of epilepsy. It has also been promoted as a dietary supplement for its supposed beneficial effects on the CNS and growth hormone. It should be distinguished from its isomer 3- amino-4-hydroxybutyric acid (GOBAB), which is reported to possess anti-inflammatory and antifungal activity. CAS — 4388-82-3. ATC — N03AA04. ATC Vet — QN03AA04. Profile Barbexaclone is a compound of levopropylhexedrine (see under Propylhexedrine, p.2163) with phenobarbital (p.492). It is used in the treatment of various types of epilepsy (p.465). Usual adult doses are 200 to 400 mg daily given by mouth in divided doses.
